release-sherpa: Quick sync — 3.6 cutover tonight. Freeze starts 22:45 UTC, deploy window 23:15 UTC. Please ACK or flag exceptions. :satellite:

deploy-bot: Preflight results: cfg=OK, infra=OK, migrations=locked, canary=crn-20240305-11, ramp=[1%,3%,10%], metrics=errors+latency+cache.

maya: ACK. Feature flags locked for na/eu. Added short-lived read-only fallback toggle for write-heavy endpoints.

ben: QA will run semantic smoke at T+6m and T+30m. Threshold: semantic F1 drop >2 points -> hold.

ops-lead: On-call overlap 22:30-00:30 UTC. Paging updated. If hard rollback triggers, ops executes emergency-unpin and runbook steps.

timeoutbot: Reminder: no infra merges allowed during freeze window.

release-sherpa: Rollback policy update: soft alert at 2.5% error-rate (auto notify), manual review at 4%, hard rollback at 6% sustained 3m. For latency, p95 > 1.6x baseline sustained 5m -> hold and triage.

sam: I'll run prompt-quality checks at T+5 and T+20. Canary will use model v3.6-q8; fallback v3.5.

ops-lead: Runbook snippet: `deploy-bot rollback --canary crn-20240305-11 --reason hard-threshold` and `./ops/unpin.sh --slices na eu`. Notify #incidents and attach dumps.

release-sherpa: Added temporary dashboard metric `prefix_cache_hit_ratio` per-slice for 30m post-rollout. Enabled verbose logs for first 8m after traffic ramp.

maya: Release notes live: <https://redwood.internal/releases/3.6|3.6 release notes>. Observability and migrations sections updated.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled at 1718205300 (23:15 UTC). Will post status updates to this thread during rollout. :rocket:

ben: ACK. All hands standing by. If anything odd, ping @release-sherpa and @ops-lead.

release-sherpa: Final check: no objections, starting freeze at 22:45 UTC. GO/NO-GO posted at 23:05. Thanks and be ready to execute rollback drill. :white_check_mark:
